I've replied to Ilse in our DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is for 185 seats.

That number comes from #north-team, a channel Ilse is in. On 20 Aug 2025 Dana posted that the amendment, signed the day before, took the account to 180 seats. A few minutes later she corrected it: "It's 185, not 180."

The amendment itself isn't in the shared files I can see, so the figure hasn't been checked against the signed copy. I told Ilse to ask Dana or June if she needs that check. A seat count counts as an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so it didn't need approval.
